items.acceptance_and_result: The canonical August 30 source and the August 31 frozen ZIP match their recorded SHA-256 digests. The earlier continuation archive is preserved unchanged. This verifies custody, not all inherited mathematics.
items.title: Recover and bind the retained source inputs

items.acceptance_and_result: The finite identity gamma=p(x)+q(y)+sum(A_i(x)+delta)(B_i(y)+delta) has explicit strict sign bounds and a fixed order-two block conversion. The toy 1+xy example is fully evaluated.
items.title: Explicitly separate every positive local coefficient

items.acceptance_and_result: Given exact J^2 data and positive tangential residue, add a normal Gram term, use a constant matrix change, and apply the fixed m^2-frame identity. The theorem leaves its global hypotheses to be instantiated.
items.title: Prove the denominator-free smooth-diagonal construction

items.acceptance_and_result: The complete parent, six contact equations, regular contact graph, exact Taylor matrix, 25 frames and rational radius are evaluated. The source/contact box and testing box vary independently. This is one normalized local domain.
items.title: Evaluate a full regular-C2 contact box

items.acceptance_and_result: Delivered: 785 order-two blocks, 1570 listed feature entries with repetitions, 237 ambient monomials, 27747 product coefficients, and 295 target coefficients in seven source columns. These do not specify a global eight-coordinate quantum lift.
items.title: Evaluate the regular-C2 feature list and product map

items.acceptance_and_result: The four displayed coefficient scalars form exactly the nonnegative orthant, with four rational necessity tests, nine polynomial square features, and an order-four diagonal pencil. August repair R5 factor typing is retained.
items.title: Extract the displayed B0 coefficient module

items.acceptance_and_result: Twenty monomials suffice when the 4-by-4 state congruence is independent of polynomial-testing variables U,V. This is a conditional envelope; it does not assert that order-two blocks survive or that the physical restoration map is known.
items.title: Bound the feature envelope under a fixed-testing-variable congruence

items.acceptance_and_result: Required: the complete state congruence, every pure-factor scaling/clearing function and its domain, the original slack identity, original-coordinate map, and every singular or zero-factor branch. The retained base asserts a congruence but does not print these data.
items.title: Supply the actual B0 radial restoration and clearing maps

items.acceptance_and_result: All six reduced forms, thirty Jacobian entries and six primitive cofactors are evaluated; all five JX=0 identities hold. This is a restricted stationary-contact parametrization, not a proof of global physical validity or boundary completeness.
items.title: Reconstruct the restricted event-contact cofactor vector

items.acceptance_and_result: The reflection SOS, attainment, all real tilt parameters, both signs, endpoint completion, and separately labelled real-closed-field factors are covered for the stated two-coordinate projection.
items.title: Certify the complete tilted-CHSH support family

items.acceptance_and_result: The order-five lift has one auxiliary and 14 nonzero upper coefficient records over Q(sqrt(2)); elimination gives order four, zero auxiliaries and 12 records. Original-coordinate substitution gives a projection cylinder.
items.title: Evaluate the tilted fixed features and affine pencils

items.acceptance_and_result: Both inclusions are proved for |t|<=1 and t^2+s^2/4<=2. The rational point (0,0,0,0,1,1,1/4,-1/4) passes all probability and relabelled tilted-family inequalities but is nonquantum.
items.title: Prove both projected inclusions and exhibit the full-set limitation

items.acceptance_and_result: A physical one-parameter complete-parent family has pairwise coprime literal remainder denominators and infinitely many linearly independent scalar remainders. This rules out that literal fixed-feature route, while the complete family itself has five fixed testing features.
items.title: Audit the literal Schur-remainder extraction route

items.acceptance_and_result: Required: a finite cover of the whole product domain, including exceptional, zero, boundary, projective, away-from-contact and normalization branches, with every restored slack identity. One regular rectangle and general local theorems do not establish the cover.
items.title: Evaluate a finite global all-source/all-test atlas

items.acceptance_and_result: For the retained order-13744 candidate route, the stated C1 canonical admission/converse gate remains open. An alternative exact full-set construction could bypass this sufficient route. It is not made true by the local C2 extraction.
items.title: Settle the retained enlarged-candidate C1 admission gate

items.acceptance_and_result: For the same retained enlarged candidate, the universal C2 admission/converse gate remains open. Exactness on the reciprocity-fixed sector or near one contact does not prove this universal gate.
items.title: Settle the retained enlarged-candidate C2 admission gate

items.acceptance_and_result: Required: one fixed finite global list with all radicands, domains, auxiliary variables and a proved completeness statement for every valid full-set affine slack. The present local counts are not global bounds.
items.title: Deliver the evaluated global feature list and actual dimensions

items.acceptance_and_result: Required: actual finite N,m and every coefficient of A0 + sum(q_nu A_nu) + sum(y_j B_j), exact algebraic encodings where necessary, and the projection to the original eight coordinates. No such exact full-set pencil is delivered.
items.title: Deliver the evaluated full eight-coordinate affine pencil

items.acceptance_and_result: Required: physical-point lifting and exclusion of every nonquantum point using the delivered fixed coefficients, with exact replayable coefficient evidence. A projection-only proof, an outer approximation or unsolved QE formula does not satisfy this gate.
items.title: Prove both full-set inclusions for that fixed pencil

items.acceptance_and_result: The full rational nine-atom physical formula, real-algebraic coefficient descent theorem and fixed-pattern decision input are explicit. The M=3 order-two input is UNSOLVED: feasibility is not established and no quantifier elimination was run. Termination of the pattern search requires the corresponding existence premise.
items.title: Specify a conditional exact algebraic extraction procedure

scope: Supplementary extraction checklist, not a replacement certification of the historical 46-item R21 existence checklist.

status_convention.COMPLETE: Complete only for the precisely stated item.
status_convention.COMPLETE_CONDITIONAL: A theorem or construction with its stated hypotheses; missing global hypotheses are not certified.
status_convention.COMPLETE_LOCAL: Complete on the displayed normalized local domain.
status_convention.COMPLETE_MODULE: Complete for the displayed abstract coefficient module.
status_convention.COMPLETE_RESTRICTED: Complete for the stated restricted contact equations.
status_convention.OPEN: The required full deliverable or proof is absent.
